preamble.DS-04:
From D006 Require Import Core Lrat.
From Stdlib Require Import NArith List.
From Stdlib Require PrimString.
Import PrimString.PStringNotations.

inventory.name: PrimString.make
inventory.reason: DS-04: cnf_text builds one-byte strings (digits, line feeds); computed by the kernel and the bytecode VM. DS-04 also uses PrimString.string (certificates and CNF text) and PrimString.cat (cnf_text), listed for DS-03

inventory.name: PrimString.length
inventory.reason: DS-04: lrat_verdict refuses certificates above 4 MiB and stops at the end of the input

inventory.name: PrimString.get
inventory.reason: DS-04: lrat_verdict reads the certificate one byte per step

inventory.name: PrimString.compare
inventory.reason: DS-04: lrat_verdict compares the given CNF text with cnf_text (PrimString.eqb); no proof depends on the comparison's result

inventory.name: PrimInt63.int
inventory.reason: DS-04: byte values and positions in a primitive string are 63-bit primitive integers

inventory.name: PrimInt63.add
inventory.reason: DS-04: advancing the read position, digit bytes of cnf_text

inventory.name: PrimInt63.ltb
inventory.reason: DS-04: the 4 MiB limit and the trailing-line test

inventory.name: PrimInt63.leb
inventory.reason: DS-04: the end-of-input test and the digit range
